title: Vedic Astrology Chart | Free Astrology Chart & Shareable Card
excerpt: Generate your Vedic astrology chart in seconds. Get a shareable astrology card, uplifting personality insights, and essential D1/D9 chart data.
content_html:
Discover Your Vedic Astrology Chart

No sign-up requiredFree chart + basic report

Enter your birth date, time, and city to get a shareable chart card and free basic report in seconds.

Choose how to enter your birth location

Type your birth city and choose one result from the list.

No sign-up required. Free basic report.

How to Get Your Vedic Astrology Chart

Three steps to your personalized Vedic astrology reading and chart:

1

Enter Your Birth Details

Enter your birth date, time, and birthplace. Add a name only if you want it shown on your chart card.

2

Generate Your Vedic Chart

Our system calculates your D1 Rashi chart and D9 Navamsa chart, then generates a personalized AI reading based on your planetary positions.

3

Download & Share

Get your shareable Vedic astrology chart card. Choose what personal info to show or hide, then download the card as an image.

What You Get with Vedic Astrology Chart

A complete Vedic astrology chart tool with free chart generation, free basic reading, and optional premium deep reports.

Free Vedic Astrology Chart Online

Generate your complete D1 chart in seconds. No account needed — just enter your birth date, time, and place.

D1 & D9 Chart Analysis

Get both the Rashi (D1) chart and the Navamsa (D9) chart with full planetary positions, house placements, and degrees.

AI-Powered Vedic Insights

Receive a free personality reading and basic insights first, then unlock premium deep analysis when you need more detail.

Shareable Chart Card

Download a beautifully designed chart card to share on Instagram, WhatsApp, or anywhere. Protect your privacy with one click.

Accurate Traditional Calculations

Calculated with a validated Vedic astrology rule set aligned with classical standards.

Multilingual Support

Use Vedic Astrology Chart in English or Chinese. More languages coming soon.

Frequently Asked Questions About Vedic Astrology Chart

Answers to common questions about Vedic astrology chart reading, calculation, and interpretation.
